directions.name: C · Sharp & structured
directions.promise: The current brand made sharper: a confident, grid-led page where the offer, price and proof line up like a well-run meeting.
directions.palette: deep-lime-studio (adapted to a light page: ink chrome, lime used only for the primary action)
directions.composition: Asymmetric 12-column Swiss grid. Hero headline spans 8 columns with the proof numbers in a ruled column to the right; services become a ruled comparison table (service, who it is for, price, action) instead of three cards.
directions.navigationChrome: Thin white header with a hairline rule; ink only in the footer and one proof band. Lime reserved for the single primary button.
directions.typeAndMaterial: Manrope 800 display at large size with tight tracking, DM Mono for labels and numbers, 0 to 4px radius, hairline rules instead of card shadows, white and pale grey surfaces.
directions.assetDirection: No generated imagery. The portrait and the real client-company logos are the only images.
directions.motionDirection: Snap: content appears with no decorative motion; hover underlines and a 120ms button press only.
directions.signatureMove: Numbered section index (01, 02, 03) that doubles as the page's table of contents.
tradeoffs: Closest to what exists, so least disruption and cheapest to build
Can still read as a tech product rather than a person
Table layout needs care on phones

directions.name: B · Warm & personal
directions.promise: A friendly, human page that feels like meeting Mark: his face and voice first, then the three ways he can help, then booking.
directions.composition: Split hero with a large rounded portrait and a handwritten-style caption; proof as a warm band; services as three soft cards with the price as a pill; a 'How a session feels' row with three steps; reviews as large quote cards.
directions.navigationChrome: Cream header that blends into the page; dark clay footer. Terracotta primary button.
directions.typeAndMaterial: Manrope for everything, generous line height, 18 to 24px radius, soft tonal shadows, cream background, warm brown ink, terracotta accent checked for 4.5:1 text contrast.
directions.assetDirection: Portrait only. No stock photos; decorative shapes are CSS.
directions.motionDirection: Spring, restrained: cards lift slightly on hover; reduced motion removes lift.
directions.signatureMove: A handwritten-style note beside the portrait ('Hi, I'm Mark. The first call is on me') that links to booking.
tradeoffs: Most approachable for people nervous about interviews
Warm palette needs contrast care on the accent

directions.name: A · Editorial & authoritative
directions.promise: A magazine-like page that reads like expert advice: a big serif headline, a clear argument, proof in pull quotes, and the guides front and centre.
directions.composition: Masthead-style header, oversized serif headline over a bounded reading column, services as a three-column 'contents' list separated by rules, a large pull quote from a client, and the free guides promoted as featured articles.
directions.navigationChrome: Black masthead rule and text links; no filled header. Off-white paper page, black footer.
directions.typeAndMaterial: Fraunces serif for display headlines only, Manrope for body and UI, 0 to 2px radius, hairline rules, off-white paper, black ink, one deep red accent for links and the primary button.
directions.assetDirection: Portrait in black and white. No generated media.
directions.motionDirection: Still: no entrance motion; underlines animate on hover.
directions.signatureMove: Section numbers set as large serif numerals in the margin, like chapters.
tradeoffs: Strongest authority and very different from typical coaching sites
Biggest change from the current site, more work to roll out to all pages
